description: Turn AI-generated feature maps into clickable source walkthroughs: call flows, jump-to-source and related-code highlights.
viewsContainers.activitybar.0.title: Code Detective
views.codeDetective.0.name: Code Map
chatParticipants.0.description: Reads source to trace call chains, then generates and opens a clickable code map
chatParticipants.0.commands.0.descriptio: Analyze a call flow and generate a code map
chatParticipants.0.commands.0.sampleRequ: The full flow from clicking the bag button to refreshing the item list
languageModelTools.0.userDescription: Search workspace source by keyword and return files and line numbers
languageModelTools.0.modelDescription: Search workspace source by keyword or regex; returns file, line and the full line text. Use it to locate entry functions and call sites.
languageModelTools.0.query.description: Text to search for; substring match by default
languageModelTools.0.regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression
languageModelTools.0.glob.description: Optional extra file filter, e.g. src/**/*.ts
languageModelTools.0.maxResults.descript: Maximum number of matches to return
languageModelTools.1.userDescription: Read a line range of a workspace file, with line numbers
languageModelTools.1.modelDescription: Read a line range of a workspace file and output it with line numbers. Always use these line numbers.
languageModelTools.2.userDescription: Write a structured call flow as a map file and open it in the view
languageModelTools.2.modelDescription: Write an explored call flow as a code map. Give only file/startLine/endLine for sources; the extension fills anchorText from the real files, validates and opens the map. Nodes and edges must reference real source locations.
languageModelTools.2.sources.description: Source location table keyed by sourceId
configuration.0.title: Code Detective
config.ai.agent.markdownDescription: Which local agent CLI generates maps. The agent reads the source itself with read-only tools inside the current workspace; the extension sends no source text. To add agents see `codeDetective.ai.cli.agents`.
config.ai.cli.command.markdownDescriptio: Path to the agent executable; leave empty to use the agent id (`claude` / `codex`). The prompt is passed via stdin, never through a shell.
config.ai.cli.extraArgs.markdownDescript: Extra arguments appended after the built-in ones, e.g. to pass `--model`.
config.ai.cli.allowedTools.markdownDescr: Tools Claude Code may use. Keep them read-only so the agent can't modify workspace source.
config.ai.cli.agents.markdownDescription: Custom agents: `id` / `label` / `command` / `args`. Use this to plug in CLIs other than claude and codex.
config.ai.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: Timeout for one agent call (ms). Default 5 minutes; leave enough time when the agent has to read many files.
languageModelTools.2.sources.note.descri: One sentence on what these lines do; shown at the end of the code line
languageModelTools.2.nodes.parent.descri: Feature block this node belongs to (another node id); omit for top level
languageModelTools.2.edges.branch.descri: Branch condition, e.g. "cache miss"; omit for the main path
